name: Pawprint Vet Clinic
description: Friendly veterinary clinic template with a trail of paw prints walking across the hero and service cards that wiggle on hover.
features: Illustrated dog-and-cat hero with live 'next slot' and rating bubbles
Six priced service cards with icons and quick Book links
Three-step new-patient guide, vet team cards and opening-hours panel
Appointment form with pet name and species fields
signature: A staggered trail of paw prints walks across the hero (paused off-screen); service cards do a playful wiggle on hover or focus
